u0: Initial phase: the agent has not yet acquired the key matching the locked door, and the door is closed. Active subtask: search the starting room and pick up the matching key; doing so enters u1 and earns the key-acquisition reward. The target box is still unreachable, so focus on getting the key before heading for the door.
u1: Key-acquired, door-not-open phase: the agent has picked up the matching key at least once, but the door remains closed. Next objective: reach the locked door while holding the key and toggle it open, which enters terminal u2 for the door-opening reward. Do not drop the key before the door opens: losing it while the door is closed triggers the key_lost penalty and leaves the agent in u1; if this happens, recover the key first, then open the door.
u2: Terminal phase: the door to the box room is open and the door-opening reward has been earned; u2 persists thereafter. The key/door obligation is complete. The remaining environment objective is to enter the right room and pick up the mission-named box; if the agent is still carrying the key, it must drop it first so the hands are free, then pick up the target box to end the episode.
